paragraphs: R. Yitzḥak Kaskasa'ah, before R. Yoḥanan, Berakhot, chapter Sheloshah She'akhlu (51, beginning of side a). Kaskasa'ah interpreted it before R. Yose bar Avin (in Alfasi: before R. Yose son of R. Ḥanina), in R. Yoḥanan's name. Yuḥasin writes 'R. Yoḥanan Kaskasa'ah' in Berakhot—a scribal error.
